title: P1 linear algebra API audit
objective: Measure and ratchet Sage-compatible public Matrix and Vector API coverage and representative performance over ZZ, QQ, and small GF(p), classify each execution path, and publish an independent implementation-lane decomposition without changing math implementations or shared registries
references: SageMath 10.9 public Matrix and Vector behavior

oracles: SageMath 10.9 public Matrix and Vector results

handoff.summary: Captured SageMath 10.9 and Sage.js public Matrix/Vector name coverage over ZZ, QQ, and GF(7); classified packed compiler-owned, generated packed FFI, dynamic Python, N-API oracle-only, and missing paths; added deterministic source/behavior ratchets, an 18-case performance audit, and a write-disjoint prioritized follow-on lane map.
risks: Sage dir() counts include broad inherited category methods, so the audit separates name coverage from 60 focused operational witnesses.
Performance limits are coarse cross-platform API regressions; the existing ring-specific dense-matrix gates remain authoritative.

The required pnpm test:native cannot pass on base commit a4fb41c: packages/flint/test/lazy-factor.cjs observes four lazy FLINT requests instead of one before reaching this lane's files. The focused dense migration suites passed in the broader CLI run, and this lane does not claim the compiler/runtime cache fix.
pnpm test:changed also reaches pre-existing runtime-intrinsic and generated documentation drift on the base commit; shared manifests and generated registries were intentionally left untouched.
next_steps: Integrate or rebase onto the compiler/runtime lazy-load fix, then rerun pnpm test:native and move this contract to review.
Start the write-disjoint linear-vector-contract, linear-matrix-selection, and linear-matrix-predicates preparation lanes described in docs/SAGE-DAYS-LINEAR-ALGEBRA-API.md.
Use a short integration-owned lane for each reviewed helper batch that edits src/baselib/matrix.py and updates the audit snapshot.
